priorCurrent01Procedure.target: Ordinarily identified enemy creatures in a20ft-radius sphere centered on the caster.
priorCurrent01Procedure.rider: NEW trigger: immediately after the caster resolves a positive post-defense/pre-temp damage packet whose actual source creature the caster perceives within20ft and LoE and ordinarily identifies as an enemy. Resolve its actual damage/Wound/lifecycle first; caster must still be able to cast and have the real Reaction. No trigger from zero prevention, inaccessible source, self-damage or merely enemy detection. On each failed target save, remove its one available ordinary Reaction if present. If absent, record one pending cancellation of the next ordinary regular-START Reaction refresh at its original next future START; expire after processing that refresh, even if the target could not act. No schedule: pending cancellation expires after6 elapsed seconds without inventing a refresh. It never removes separately granted special Reactions or resets a resource. Multiple pending losses on the same target cancel that same one next ordinary refresh, with no queue into further turns.
priorCurrent01Procedure.new: Missing trigger, WIS half and finite next-Reaction loss semantics are explicit choices; Reaction denial remains distinct from hard whole-Action control.

matches.resolution: Retain earlier completed-hostile-use trigger, point-centered20ft sphere, INT save and finite next-elected-Reaction debt including actual special Reactions. Preserve current01 retaliation/WIS/ordinary-refresh alternative as history; it has not replaced the earlier fuller proposal.

At the next future actual regular START after normal required processing, spend up to10ft of actual remaining ordinary movement safely away from the caster position recorded at application on its actual plane, using real terrain/crawl/squeeze cost. No Dash, Action loss, forced teleport, owner BA, optional expenditure, self-destructive route or new movement mode. Direction never homes to a later caster. Owner-attached target: use only its actual phase after the next original-owner regular turn not already begun, bounded by that original recorded phase marker. No original schedule: expire at application+6 seconds; a normal independent out-of-initiative body may use one safe movement opportunity in the real ordinary budget by that time, establishing initiative before hostile behavior. Missing phase, different plane, suppression, zero Speed, blocked route or no safe path consumes the check and expires the instruction without retry. Preserve original latest marker through reorder/absence; a lawful earlier actual opportunity may consume it once, a later repair/phase cannot replay it. This is a NEW spell-scoped proposal parallel to pending DE4, not inheritance of an accepted Compulsion extension.
